definitions.gloss: to fall deeply in love with, to be captivated by
definitions.explanation: To become thoroughly enamored or deeply attracted to someone or something. Stronger than simple liking — implies being completely won over. Used for romantic attraction, but also for being captivated by a place, a work of art, or an idea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I fell head over heels for her.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}んで、⟦{移住|いじゅう}→移住：13752_ijuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I was so captivated by the scenery here that I decided to move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{脚本|きゃくほん}→脚本：04459_kyakuhon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}み、⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}た→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧。
examples.english: He was so taken with the screenplay that he volunteered to direct it himself.

notes:
Godan verb (む-ending). {惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}む → {惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}まない → {惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}んだ → {惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}んで

USAGE:
{惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}む is an intensified form of ⟦{惚|ほ}れる→惚れる：12600_horeru⟧ (to fall in love with). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the sense of depth and thoroughness — being deeply and completely captivated.

Used for both romantic and non-romantic contexts. Often takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the object of fascination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}む: to be captivated by ~
- ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}む: to be completely smitten
- ⟦{一目|ひとめ}→一目：08728_hitome⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{惚|ほ}れ{込|こ}む: to be captivated at first sight
